name: pam_nfc
detailed_description: NFC-based authentication module allowing users to authenticate by presenting an NFC-enabled card, token, or smartphone. Supports contactless authentication for physical access and login.

parameters.uid_field: NFC field to extract user ID from

notes:
Requires NFC hardware and proper key provisioning. Suitable for physical access control.
